title: Liquid Time
description: A retexture for the Time in a bottle!
body: This is a simple resource pack that changes the Time in a bottle texture found in the [Time in a bottle](https://modrinth.com/mod/time-in-a-bottle-universal) / [Time in a bottle standalone](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/time-in-a-bottle-standalone) mods!
